tasks.title: Create a form with Google Forms
steps:
In this task, you need to create a form by performing the steps that follow.

1. Create a Google Forms blank file named Our Solar System and give the form the title of Our Solar System.
2. Configure the form settings to collect verified email addresses.
3. Add the Short answer question type and enter the question as Student Name to the form Our Solar System.

tasks.title: Add questions to the form
steps:
In this task, you need to add questions to the form by performing the steps that follow.

1. An image named Solar System.png is available in your Google Drive. Attach the Solar System.png image to the form Our Solar System after the Student Name question. Enter the image title as Solar System.
2. Select the Short answer question type and enter the question as How many moons does Mercury have?.
3. Select the Multiple choice question type and enter the question as What is the third planet from the sun? with Option 1 specified as Mercury, Option 2 specified as Venus, Option 3 specified as Earth and Option 4 specified as Mars.
4. Select the Dropdown question type and enter the question as Which is the largest planet? with Option 1 specified as Jupiter, Option 2 specified as [Saturn], Option 3 specified as Uranus, and Option 4 specified as Neptune.

tasks.title: Configure document settings
steps:
In this task, you configure the Google Docs document to ensure the following:

1. Editors cannot change permissions and share the document.
2. Viewers and commenters cannot see the option to download, print and copy.
